attributes.additional_details: Residents of Blackwell Road, Coventry, face difficulties finding parking near their homes due to vehicles belonging to non-residents occupying available spaces. We request a residents-only parking permit scheme to prioritise local households, reduce congestion and improve safety. This petition is specifically for people living on Blackwell Road, and we ask only Blackwell Road residents to sign and support this request.
attributes.background: We request a residents-only parking permit scheme on Blackwell Road, Coventry, to prevent non-residents occupying parking spaces and ensure residents can park near their homes. This petition is intended exclusively for people living on Blackwell Road, and only these residents should sign.

rejection.details: This is a local matter which doesn't fall under the direct responsibility of the Government or of Parliament. It is materially a matter for the local authority. You may wish to contact them or your local councillor.
